'''Dianxiao''' is an NPC in {{Location|Jinzhou}}.

During the event [[By Moon's Grace]], Dianxiao is an NPC in [[Taoyuan Vale]] for the [[Fan Drawing Stall]].

{{Map Embed|Taoyuan Vale|Dianxiao}}--->

==Dialogue==
===Event Dialogue===
====By Moon's Grace====
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(First interaction)
:'''Dianxiao''': The brushwork is exquisite...
:'''Dianxiao''': Oh, hello! Interested in painting your own fan? What shape would you like?
:{{DIcon}} What types of fans do you have?
::'''Dianxiao''': We have round fans and folding fans available.
:{{DIcon}} Can I really paint a fan myself?
::'''Dianxiao''': Absolutely! Many quests have created their own fan as a special keepsake.
:'''Dianxiao''': The Huaipu Mining Firm sponsors this fan drawing stall to showcase Jinzhou's unique fan art.
:'''Dianxiao''': Imagine meeting some renowned painters here? Oh, what a treat!
:'''Dianxiao''': Mesmerizing landscapes and delicate wildlife... you can draw anything on a fan.
:'''Dianxiao''': I wonder what thoughts inspire the painters as they create.
:'''Dianxiao''': Anyway, please take your time to choose. Enjoy the selection process!
----
:'''Dianxiao''': Would you prefer landscapes or calligraphy on your fan? 
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Dianxiao''': You see, the brushstrokes in this landscape captures the essence of these towering mountains with such precision.
::'''Dianxiao''': My uncle used to say that mastering just one aspect of a painting takes a lifetime.
::'''Dianxiao''': Now I see what he meant.
::'''Dianxiao''': I guess I'll have the chance to appreciate more artwork at this year's Fair.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
